topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Security Gateway Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS Cross-Site Request Forgery Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Cisco IOS 12.4 contains multiple cross-site forgery vulnerabilities that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via (1) a certain "show privilege" command to the /level/15/exec/- URI, and (2) a certain "alias exec" command to the /level/15/exec/-/configure/http URI.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Google Chrome FreeType Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Google Chrome uses FreeType, an open-source software library to render fonts, which contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the function Load_SBit_Png when processing PNG images embedded into fonts. This vulnerability is part of an exploit chain with CVE-2020-17087 on Windows and CVE-2020-16010 on Android.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

topMovers.product: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

highestSignals.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.
Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.
